# Configuration

Every environment variable the backend reads, extracted directly from the source so this list cannot silently drift. A variable with no default is required for the feature it belongs to; most of them are optional and simply turn a feature off when unset (see the log line the server prints at startup for which).

| Variable | Default |
|---|---|
| `AI_API_KEY` | *(required or empty = off)* |
| `AI_BASE_URL` | *(required or empty = off)* |
| `AI_MODEL` | *(required or empty = off)* |
| `AI_PROVIDER` | `deepseek` |
| `AI_REASONING` | *(required or empty = off)* |
